description: Known Koopman eigenfunctions of this system, as data: exact expressions in its state, parameter and dimensionless-group names, with the conditions under which they hold.

references.brizard: Brizard, Jacobi zeta function and action-angle coordinates for the pendulum, arXiv:1108.4970
references.jaffe: Jaffe and Brumer (1984), J. Phys. Chem. 88:4829-4839, section II.F

eigenfunctions.title: Energy H = v^2/2 + a(1 - cos theta)
eigenfunctions.derivation: conserved by the configured field: eigenvalue 0

eigenfunctions.title: Libration phase exp(i phi)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero damping and driver; libration 0 < H < 2a, |theta| < pi
eigenfunctions.derivation: theta = 2 asin(k sn(u|k^2)), v = 2 k sqrt(a) cn(u|k^2), phi = pi u/(2K): dphi/dt = Omega(H)

eigenfunctions.title: Rotation phase exp(i phi_r)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero damping and driver; rotation H > 2a
eigenfunctions.derivation: |v| = sqrt(2H) sqrt(1 - m sin^2(theta/2)), so dF(theta/2|m)/dt = sign(v) sqrt(H/2)

eigenfunctions.title: Oscillatory mode (lambda = -b/2 + i w)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero driver; underdamped; near the hanging equilibrium
eigenfunctions.derivation: left eigenvectors of Df(0) = [[0, 1], [-a, -b]], b = damping/(m l^2)

eigenfunctions.title: Conjugate oscillatory mode
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero driver; underdamped; near the hanging equilibrium
eigenfunctions.derivation: left eigenvectors of Df(0) = [[0, 1], [-a, -b]], b = damping/(m l^2)
